g.text: A knowledge base (KB) is a set of formulas.
ASK it what is known; TELL it something new
Expert system = knowledge base + inference engine.
it derives consequences with modus ponens and other rules
A query may be settled, refuted, or neither.
derived: the letter is in the right drawer
now the KB settles both: inconsistent
A derivation shows what follows from the KB, not what is true.
A rule-based system can point at the facts and rules behind an answer.
